Density measurement test on all soil at relative density between 0.85 and 0.95; apparatus: air-powered chipping hammer; loading: three passes per layer; about three inches thick. Recorded: relative density after vibratory compaction.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::
